tasks.label: git-diff-small
tasks.command: git diff api/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts api/src/bots/bots.service.ts web/src/app/community/page.tsx web/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx web/src/components/pages/PostPage.tsx

tasks.label: check-node-processes
tasks.command: Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,Path | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: find-api-watchers
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'nest|prisma|webthuebot|api' } | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine | Format-List

tasks.label: find-api-watchers2
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'node.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'nest|prisma|webthuebot|api' } | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine | Format-List

tasks.label: find-api-watchers3
tasks.command: $procs = Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($p in $procs) { $cl = (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId = ' + $p.Id)).CommandLine; if ($cl -match 'nest|prisma|webthuebot|api') { Write-Output ($p.Id.ToString() + ' ' + $cl) } }

tasks.label: prisma-migrate-status
tasks.command: cd api; npx prisma migrate status

tasks.label: seed-db
tasks.command: cd api; npx prisma db seed

tasks.label: grep-useRole
tasks.command: cd web; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Include *.tsx,*.ts src | Select-String -Pattern 'useRole' | Select-Object -First 50 | ForEach-Object { $_.Path + ':' + $_.LineNumber }

tasks.label: grep-hardcoded-colors
tasks.command: cd web; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Include *.tsx src | Select-String -Pattern 'zinc-|#111113|#121214|#9CA3AF|#252528' | Group-Object Path | ForEach-Object { $_.Name + '  (' + $_.Count + ')' }

tasks.label: admin-zinc-grep
tasks.command: cd web; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Include *.tsx src/app/admin,src/components/admin | Select-String -Pattern 'zinc-' | Select-Object -First 30 | ForEach-Object { $_.Path + ':' + $_.LineNumber + ' ' + $_.Line.Trim() }

tasks.label: grep-import-useRole-v2
tasks.command: cd web; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Include *.tsx src | Select-String -Pattern "import.*RoleContext|useRole\(" | ForEach-Object { $_.Path + ':' + $_.LineNumber + ' ' + $_.Line.Trim() }

tasks.label: grep-import-useRole-v3
tasks.command: cd web; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Include *.tsx src | Select-String -Pattern 'RoleContext|useRole\(' | ForEach-Object { $_.Path + ':' + $_.LineNumber + ' ' + $_.Line.Trim() }
